comments.author: Sophia
comments.body:
well no it's the exact opposite. When the cards expire:

'Empress' card restores 25% durability of EQUIPPED ship parts, but only if you are out at sea.

'World" card restores 25% durability of EQUIPPED items, but only if you are out at sea.

And then only sometimes (most of the time, just not all of the time)

'Fool' card gives you a chance of recovering some item or trade good(s) that have been discarded nearby, this works on land or at sea.

the other card (the name eludes me) gives you less vigour consumption when using production skills while it is in effect, and as best as I can tell, it has no effect on expiration.
